## Change and purpose

Describe the concrete change and the requirement it addresses.

## Task

Link the actual YouTrack issue. Until the project exists, identify the local planning reference and state that YouTrack traceability is pending.

## Acceptance and verification

List acceptance criteria and the checks actually performed. Distinguish documentation checks from application tests or empirical results.

## Review

Request review by another team member. Record supervisor feedback at the agreed checkpoints. Do not mark approval before it occurs.
